//: Emit config. Identical to tsconfig.json except that specs are excluded from dist/.
The split exists because the two consumers want different file sets. ESLint's project
service and the editor need specs INCLUDED or they cannot be type-aware linted — excluding
them produced 'was not found by the project service'. The build needs them EXCLUDED, or
compiled .spec.js files land in dist/ and vitest then runs every test twice, once from
source and once from output. Both were observed at PH-0.19.
